mapping.url: canonical public listing URL on an approved host
mapping.title: advertised title
mapping.city: must be Kraków for this profile
mapping.rent_pln: advertised monthly base rent in whole PLN
mapping.fees_pln: monthly fees in PLN or null when unknown
mapping.commission_pln: commission in PLN; null means unknown, zero means known zero
mapping.status: active, inactive only with explicit provider removal evidence, or unknown
mapping.observed_at: provider observation/check time in ISO-8601 UTC

pagination: next_url must be HTTPS on an exact allowed host; preflight samples at most one page
removals: absence from a page is not removal; require an explicit inactive item and newer observed_at
permitted_reuse: Obtain written provider permission for automated access, storage, display, retention and redistribution before enabling collection.
authentication: Set OLX_FEED_TOKEN in the process environment or an ignored local env file. Never put credentials in URLs or tracked config.
provider_capability: This is an example contract only. It does not assert OLX offers a partner feed or that an account API covers marketplace listings.
